policy: Current operator schedule is source evidence, not individual dated event approval
One physical CL2 anchor; aliases never mint new church
No unsafe extrapolation of 1962 rite from Latin language
No automatic SSPX ownership from chapel listed in district directory
Alternative Sunday clocks and conditional month-week recurrence not flattened
Special feasts and expired bulletins supersede generalized claims only within dated validity
